fetched: Fetch finished! Fetched %s1% words in %s2% ms!
noPerm: You don't have permission to use this command!
alreadyBlocked: This word sequence is already blocked!
notBlocked: This word sequence is not blocked!

help-2: - /cw reload - reloads the configuration and word lists
help-3: - /cw filter - shows the list of manually blocked words
help-4: - /cw filter add <word sequence> - adds a sequence to the list of manually blocked words
help-5: - /cw filter remove <word sequence> - removes a sequence from the list of manually blocked words
